correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and alpha>max(-1,-(n-1)/2), the positive kernel on the unit-ball diameter and normalized sphere has Schur comparisons Th=A g F(r²)/F(1), T*g<=B h, AB=C, with h=(1-<xi,eta>²)^(-(n-1)/4), g=(1-r²)^(-(n-1)/2). The stated Gauss hypergeometric F has two negative numerator parameters, positive denominator, positive convergence excess, and strictly increases on [0,1]. Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz yields a nonnegative defect ≥∫|f|²/h T*(A g-Th). On |r|≤1/2 the strict F(r²)<F(1) gap plus positive Poisson/measure kernel lower bounds produce the displayed κ(δ)>0. The cap complement geometry gives 1/h≥[δ²(1-δ²/4)]^((n-1)/4). Thus no nonzero L² equality, and all normalized norm-extremizing sequences concentrate outside any fixed complement of antipodal caps; no converse. Independently confirmed six gamma/hypergeometric constants and positive κ for six parameter samples; all-parameter claim depends on reconstructed analytic Schur argument and cited exact primary beta identities.
